subject: land animals
title: The 5 Heaviest Land Animals, Ranked (The Giraffe Misses Out)

scenes.text: The giraffe is the tallest animal on land. It doesn't even make this list.
Number five: the hippo. A big male averages about one and a half tons.
scenes.label: Hippo · 1.5 tons

scenes.text: Number four: the African forest elephant. Smaller than its cousins, around two tons.
scenes.label: Forest elephant · ~2 tons

scenes.text: Number three: the white rhino. Males weigh about 2.3 tons, all from eating grass.
scenes.label: White rhino · 2.3 tons

scenes.text: Number two: the Asian elephant. An adult male averages about four tons.
scenes.label: Asian elephant · 4 tons

scenes.text: Number one: the African bush elephant. Males average six tons, about as much as four family cars.
scenes.label: Bush elephant · 6 tons

description:
Average adult male masses: African bush elephant about 6 t, Asian elephant about 4 t, white rhino about 2.3 t, African forest elephant about 2 t (an estimate) and hippo about 1.5 t. Large Indian rhinos can rival hippos; giraffes weigh 0.7-2 t.
Figures from Larramendi (2016) and San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance fact sheets.
Which animal surprised you most on this list?
